analyst.summary: Astra Microwave Products makes radar and microwave subsystems for India's defence and space programmes, and just secured a transformative Rs 2,205 crore order from HAL (July 2026) that roughly doubles its order book with five years of execution visibility. The stock is richly valued (~85x earnings) and current returns on capital (ROE ~9%) have not yet caught up to the growth story. We rate it a Hold.
